about.intro: Yachay Open Science Week 2026 is an interdisciplinary open-science congress bringing together students, researchers, and innovators at Yachay Tech from October 19–24, 2026.
about.objective: Our goal is to drive open collaboration across disciplines, connecting scientific and technological talent from Ecuador and the region.
about.value.inter.desc: All sciences in conversation: from molecules to territory.
about.value.open.desc: Free knowledge, FAIR data, and reproducibility.
about.value.community.desc: Seedbeds, young researchers, alumni, and civil society.
about.value.link.desc: University, industry, and territory working for development.

idea.intro: Interdisciplinary teams spend the week solving real campus and territory challenges, with mentoring and an awards ceremony.
idea.body: The Ideathon runs alongside the congress all week: teams form across majors and schools, and work through mentoring sessions until the closing awards ceremony.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.who.q: Who can take part in YOSW 2026?
faq.who.a: Students, faculty, researchers from any institution, alumni, and the general public interested in science.
faq.cost.a: No. YOSW is a free event thanks to the support of Universidad Yachay Tech and its partners. Registration is required for capacity control.
faq.submit.q: How do I submit a talk or poster?
faq.submit.a: Send your proposal through the registration form, selecting the corresponding option. The scientific committee will review and notify results.
faq.ideathon.q: What is the Ideathon and how do I join?
faq.ideathon.a: It's the week's flagship challenge: interdisciplinary teams work on real challenges with mentoring and a closing awards ceremony. You can sign up through the form.
faq.certificate.a: Yes: attendance and work-presentation certificates, issued by the university.
faq.remote.a: Yes. YOSW is hybrid: keynote sessions, panels, and ceremonies will be streamed through the congress's official channels.
sede.heading: Congress venue
sede.body: YOSW 2026 takes place at the Universidad Yachay Tech campus, Hacienda Yachay, Urcuquí — Imbabura province, Ecuador; a unique Andean setting where science meets the landscape.
sede.hybrid: Virtual sessions are streamed through the official channels for participants across the country and the world.
